title: RustyBot Client 2.0.64 — 29/08/26
raw:
**WHAT'S NEW**

**Fully Modular UI & Customization**
- **Remove UI Elements:** When the UI is unlocked (Custom UI Mode), each removable element shows an × button. Click it to hide elements like Current Prize & Donator, Entry Requirement, Selected Winner, Prize Controls, Entrants Panel, and more.
- **Restore Hidden Elements:** Navigate to Options ➔ Layout ➔ "Removed UI Elements" to bring back any hidden panels with a single click.
- **Master Switch Toggle:** A new "Allow removing UI elements" toggle lets you disable the × buttons and lock down your interface.
- **Protected Core Panels:** Core elements (Main Action Buttons, Main Panel, and Confirmation & Response) are protected so you can never accidentally remove vital controls.

**Multi-Monitor & Layout Controls**
- **Launch on Monitor:** Added a new "Launch on Monitor" option under Options ➔ Layout. Pick which screen RustyBot opens on, and it will start there maximized.
- **Relocated Options Button:** The OPTIONS button has been moved to the status bar, keeping it separate from action buttons and accessible at all times.

**Simplified Text Controls**
- **Preset Text Sizes:** Replaced the font slider with a simple Small / Medium / Large dropdown menu for instant adjustments.

**Previous winners**
Feature request * included a separate box that shows the last prize!

**Monitor (used to be called log)**
changed the name to Monitor and included a clear button, this window has overgone a rework removing all non vital logs from it.

**WHAT'S FIXED & IMPROVED**

**Display & Window Behaviour**
- **Multi-Monitor Scaling Fix:** Moving RustyBot to a different screen now automatically scales the interface (panels and text) to fit, eliminating overlapping panels and cut-off content.
- **Options Window Screen Tracking:** The Options window now opens on the same screen as the main app and resizes dynamically so it never extends past display bounds.
- **Smart Window Bounds:** Panels can no longer be dragged or resized off-screen; they will automatically snap back inside the visible window.

**Text & Layout Stability**
- **Universal Text Scaling:** Text size settings now apply uniformly across the entire app—including the confirmation log and message cards—rather than just the buttons.
- **Preserved Panel Layouts:** Changing font size now only adjusts the text, keeping your custom panel arrangements intact without shifting them.

**Animations**
- Fixed all sound and flow issues with all animations, animations will no longer show old winners

**Token control across all platforms**
With the future plan to move to a central token system, work has gone into reinforcing that token delivery to the client. this should mean less drops from kick and a more stable connection to Velora and twitch

**Patch Version**
2.0.64
